_about: Director layout for V07 page 11. Units: pt, origin top-left. Two cinematic tiers: the marked tickets outside the Gate, then the larger reveal inside Entry Court (empty Moon Bell stand, Tara).
hierarchy: The reveal of the empty stand is the page's focal point, so the lower tier is taller.

panels.compose: Slightly elevated medium-close view, very wide. Ahana kneeling frame-left, Vihaan crouching centre, Navya kneeling right, each holding a marked ticket face-up towards Tez, who is at right-centre with a forepaw on the edge of Navya's ticket. The open emergency door behind them at right. Upper-left 46% x 30% calm for a three-line caption.

Eye-level medium-wide reveal. Empty circular Moon Bell stand on its stepped base slightly left of centre, complete with its empty suspension ring and slack rope; Tara standing to its right with staff and open palm; the wall map's edge at frame-right. Upper-left 36% x 22% calm (night sky / court wall) for a two-line caption.
